english.note: Use this for a large passenger ship, especially one operating on a regular route; use 遠洋客輪 when emphasizing an ocean liner.

examples.english: This liner travels between Hong Kong and Macao every day.
examples.traditional: 呢艘客輪每日往返香港同澳門。
